Main.label: Management accounts and data room Accounts, a revenue export
Main.afterText: EVIDENCE The more evidence you add, the better the memo. Public sources get a diligence started. Value and accuracy come from what nobody has published: customer interviews, the ones who left as much as the ones who stayed, and the founders and teams of your competitors. Every layer turns estimates into verified claims. Public sources and filings What the agents fetch themselves. Always on. AGENTS Management accounts and data room Accounts, a revenue export, contracts. Agents read, grade and cross-check them. YOU UPLOAD Interviews with loyal customers Why they stay and what they would pay for. Upload the calls, or we run them. YOU OR US Interviews with churned customers Why they left and what they moved to. The claim no deck makes. YOU OR US Competitors: founders and teams What the alternatives really build, and who builds it. Method.label: 1 Market Demand is moving from point tools to platforms in t
Method.afterText: FIVE STAGES Every claim graded. Scroll to watch a memo get built. The main trunk of the method has five stages, from the market to the first 100 days. Supporting skills feed them with cohorts, interviews and a user panel. STAGE 1, MARKET How big is the market? A first-principles view of the market, then a sourced deep dive: sizing, value chain, players, M&A and the five trends that matter. STAGE 2, COMPANY Is it a good company? A two-page memo: financials or proxy signals, ownership, founders, an evidence-backed SWOT. Fed by customer and expert interviews STAGE 3, PRODUCT Does it grow? What breaks at 10x? Retention, adoption, red flags and a verdict: Invest, Conditional or Pass. Fed by cohort analysis, a user panel and interviews STAGE 4, TECHNOLOGY Does the tech back the claims? A six-axis scorecard on the same verdict scale, checking what the product story could only claim. STAGE 5, FIRST 100 DAYS What do we fix first? Sized levers, a 100-day plan, the metrics that prove it worked and the board asks. Northwind · Memo Illustrative VERDICT Pending Builds as the stages complete. 1 Market Demand is moving from point tools to platforms in the mid-market. S-03 single analyst estimate C 2 3 4 5 A Verified B Reported C Estimated A second model family reviews what the first one wrote.

Platform.label: Do I have to paste an API key?
Platform.afterText: QUESTIONS Before you sign in. Do I have to paste an API key? No. You connect your own provider account through a secure third-party connection and approve access on your provider's own screen. We never collect or store your key, and you can revoke access from your provider at any time. At launch you can connect Claude, OpenAI, Mistral and Gemini. The independent verifier runs on a different model family than the writers, so connect two. Your first diligence is a capped trial on us, so you can read a memo before you connect anything. Need another provider? Ask for a connector. What will a diligence cost me? Who can read my documents? Can I take my work with me? Is this investment advice?

Platform.label: What will a diligence cost me?
Platform.afterText: QUESTIONS Before you sign in. Do I have to paste an API key? What will a diligence cost me? You see it before it runs. The plan lists each agent with its model and an estimate, you can switch to a cheaper or a stronger setting and watch the total move, and you set a cap. The run stops at the cap, and the actual cost sits next to the estimate. Who can read my documents? Can I take my work with me? Is this investment advice?

Platform.label: Who can read my documents?
Platform.afterText: QUESTIONS Before you sign in. Do I have to paste an API key? What will a diligence cost me? Who can read my documents? Your workspace members, and nobody else. Agents work in isolated sandboxes that hold no keys and can only reach a short list of hosts. Documents that a target shared with you are only sent to model providers that do not retain or train on them. The security page has the detail. Can I take my work with me? Is this investment advice?

Platform.label: Can I take my work with me?
Platform.afterText: QUESTIONS Before you sign in. Do I have to paste an API key? What will a diligence cost me? Who can read my documents? Can I take my work with me? Yes. Memos export as Word and PDF, the ledger exports as a file, and your evidence goes with it. The method itself is open source, so you can run it without us. Is this investment advice?

Platform.label: Is this investment advice?
Platform.afterText: QUESTIONS Before you sign in. Do I have to paste an API key? What will a diligence cost me? Who can read my documents? Can I take my work with me? Is this investment advice? No. It produces evidence-graded analysis for the people who make the decision. You and your committee own the call, and every claim shows its source so you can check it.

Products.afterText: 05 · VAULT AT LAUNCH A vault we host, and cannot read. Term sheets, partner notes and your own view of a founder belong in a vault, not in a prompt. It is hosted by us and encrypted in your browser. The agents read nothing until you say so. Hosted, encrypted in your browser. The key comes from your passphrase and stays with you. We store only ciphertext. Lose the passphrase and the recovery code, and the vault is gone: we say so plainly. Agents are locked out by default. A note reaches a run only when you share it for that target. The read is logged. Plain markdown, no lock-in. Notes with links between them. Import an Obsidian vault, export a zip that Obsidian opens unchanged. Linked to the work. A note can link a target, a source or a section, and shows up as a backlink in its lineage. Prefer Obsidian? From Pro. At launch A plugin in your vault pairs with a one-time code and shares only the notes you mark. The rest stays on your side, and we hold no key to it. Another vault? Suggest it. The requests we count decide what we connect next.
